page.layout: One printed page. Running head centred at top, page number top right. Main text in one column: first a set-off list of syllogism lines with mnemonic syllables and numbers in the left and right margins, then a paragraph, a title, a chapter heading, a paragraph with two more syllogisms set in the margin, and closing paragraphs. No notes below the text.

l.i: Quidam igitur Philosophi mærore non conficiuntur.

main_text.p: Locus est ex genere ad speciem, cuius hoc firmamentum est: Quod generi repugnat, idē speciei repugnat. Nam propositio repugnantium ratione sustinetur: assumptio generis.
main_text.head: De quatuor secunda figura modis.
CAP. VI.
main_text.p: CæfareQVOT sunt Modi secūde figure? Quatuor: quorū primus est cùm ex propositione vniuersali negatiua, & assumptione vniuersali affirmatiua, sequitur conclusio vniuersalis negatiua. veluti,

Locus est ex proprio: cuius hoc firmamentum est, Quod proprio non conuenit, speciei non conuenit. Nam propositio repugnantium ratione animatur: assumptio proprij. Repugnat autem sapientem esse, & non bene ratione uti.
Quis est secundus? Cùm ex conuersis superioribus propositionibus conuersa conclusio efficitur. Sola enim propositionum inuersione à superiore discrepat. veluti,

page.notes: Mnemonic syllables (Fe ri o; Cæ fa re) and the numbers 1–5 beside the syllogisms are marginal references and have been placed as notes. Printed "secūde" and "bene u-/titur" are kept as printed with macron and hyphen. The woodcut initial "Q" of "QVOT" is joined to the first word. Some small numbers and braces in the margins are read approximately and may be imperfect.
